brief: UBS S&T's Deleveraging Indicator stays "on" for US and Japan Equity Long/Short, while Europe Equity L/S pauses. Gross outflows in Equity L/S have moderated in the US and Europe, but October was the worst year-to-date performance month for Equity L/S in both regions, so the indicator stays "on" even though gross reductions have stabilised, because performance remains tough. In Japan, Equity L/S reduced gross exposure by -1 standard deviation following Tuesday's market close. Quant strategies also had a difficult start to the month on performance. US Quant gross outflows were muted yesterday while EU Quant strategies reduced exposure by -0.7 standard deviations. Current indicator status: Equity L/S US "on" for a fifth consecutive session, Europe paused after two consecutive "on" sessions, Japan "on" for a second consecutive session; Quant US "on" for a third consecutive session, Europe "off", Japan "off" but close to triggering. The note reports these indicator readings; it does not state a trade recommendation.
